declarations.name: AuiProgressBar

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Current value, clamped to [min, max]. null renders an indeterminate bar without aria-valuenow.

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: Maximum value; must be greater than min.

inputs.name: valueText
inputs.description: Custom value text for aria-valuetext and the visible value. Default: localized percentage.

inputs.name: tone
inputs.description: Semantic tone; non-default tones add a labelled icon.

inputs.name: showValue
inputs.description: Render the value text next to the label.

inputs.name: announceComplete
inputs.description: Announce "{label} complete" politely once when the value reaches max.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA progressbar role (ARIA 1.2) with a visible label.

limitations: Completion is announced once per transition to max; values that stay at max do not re-announce. A bar created at max does not announce.
